brief_rationale: The trajectory met the responsibility chain: the doctor screened and acted on neurologic red flags, treated the headache in the context of atrial fibrillation/vascular disease, prevented self-directed medication changes, escalated to ED/120 when symptoms persisted and the patient resisted, tracked pending imaging/labs, and ended with an executable follow-up/medication plan. There is no serious or minor responsibility-chain error visible in the completed episode. At least two high-order points were actively completed with trajectory impact: the doctor avoided anchoring on either neuralgia or stroke alone, and dynamically reprioritized from home triage to ED, then to neurovascular follow-up and cardiology/antithrombotic review. Closure is safe and traceable through the doctor’s final timing/backup plan and the family’s teach-back, supporting grade 5.
